title: NIST Dictionary of Algorithms and Data Structures: multiprocssr

multiprocessor model
multiprocessor model
(definition)
Definition:
A
model of parallel computation
based on a set of communicating sequential processors.
See also
Turing machine
,
work-depth model
.
